title: Item lookup returns another user's item
description: A signed-in user reads an item that belongs to another dummy user.
root_cause: The handler calls the store with the request id and never compares the item owner with the caller.

trace.description: Reads the id from the query string.
Returns the item body to the caller.

evidence.description: No owner comparison between lookup and response.

execution.observed_result: The local test returned dummy user 2's item to dummy user 1.
